mechanism: Buspirone is metabolized by CYP3A4, and primaquine may have modest effects on CYP3A4 activity; additionally, both drugs can cause CNS effects and primaquine carries hemolytic risk in G6PD-deficient patients requiring monitoring.
action: Monitor for increased buspirone adverse effects (dizziness, drowsiness); ensure G6PD status is known before primaquine use; consider dose adjustment if CNS symptoms emerge.
